newsitem.title: USA: AMBI sees summer Nisin IND, seeks diet buy.
newsitem.headline: AMBI sees summer Nisin IND, seeks diet buy.

text.p: AMBI Inc said Thursday that it expects to file an Investigational New Drug application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for Nisin, its lead antimicrobial compound, this summer.
AMBI also said that it is in discussions to acquire products that complement its Cardia Salt Alternative business.

The company said that it has begun working with Merck & Co Inc's Merck-Medco Managed Care LLC to investigate opportunities to deliver educational information on Cardia Salt Alternative to physicians and patients.
